_comment: Where things physically are, in a shared robot frame. Origin: centre of the
cart's top tray at tray level; +x forward (the way the robot faces), +y to
the robot's LEFT (measured, see lex-robot#163), +z up.
Each entry carries its provenance. SOURCED values come from the XLeRobot
project or IKEA; ESTIMATE values are still eyeballed from photographs and
are what limits this model's accuracy.
Free validation data: probe_range.py recorded the shoulder_pan angles at
which each arm actually met the tower. A correct model must predict
collisions at roughly those angles -- check that before relying on it.

_sources.cart: IKEA RASKOG utility cart, article 40582181 -- named in XLeRobot's bill of materials (xlerobot.readthedocs.io hardware/getting_started/material.html). Published size 35 x 45 x 78 cm, 3 tiers, 13 lb per shelf.
_sources.arm_mounts: XLeRobot's own simulation constant ARM_MOUNT = left [0.25, 0.15, 0.40] / right [0.25, -0.15, 0.40] (this repo, gym_env/xlerobot_sim.py) -- +/-0.15 m laterally, consistent with arms near the ends of the 45 cm tray.
_sources.servo_count: XLeRobot 0.4.0 uses 17 STS3215 servos: 12 arms + 3 base + 2 head. The 2 head servos are this unit's tower pan/tilt (IDs 7 and 8). NOTE this build has a 2-wheel differential base (IDs 9, 10), not the 3 the 0.4.0 spec lists.
_sources.tower: NOT PUBLISHED. The XLeRobot docs describe the head as 2 servos but give no mast dimensions, and the assembly page for 0.4.0 is not reachable. Still an estimate.

left._provenance: SOURCED (y from XLeRobot ARM_MOUNT); yaw is an ESTIMATE and probably wrong -- the arms look mirrored

right._provenance: SOURCED (y from XLeRobot ARM_MOUNT); yaw is an ESTIMATE and probably wrong

tower._provenance: ESTIMATE -- not published anywhere reachable. Central 3D-printed mast carrying the head camera on 2 servos.

cart._provenance: SOURCED -- IKEA RASKOG 35 x 45 x 78 cm. Modelled as a half-space: nothing may go below the top tray. tray_z = 0 defines the frame origin.

link_radii._provenance: ESTIMATE -- conservative capsules enclosing each link plus its sleeve and cabling. Keyed by the link a capsule ENDS at; 'default' is the fallback.
